subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

A mental condition where a person feels an uncontrollable urge to steal.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2, i.e., Kleptomania.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Kleptomania"** refers to a mental condition where a person has an uncontrollable urge to steal, often without any personal or monetary gain. (चोरी की बेकाबू आदत) • **Example:** The shoplifting incident was not due to financial need but because of her kleptomania. • It is classified as a psychological disorder and is often treated with therapy or counseling. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Kleptomania**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Pyromania** (आग लगाने की बेकाबू आदत): An uncontrollable urge to set things on fire. • **Example:** His fascination with fire led to a diagnosis of pyromania. • **Bibliomania** (पुस्तकों के संग्रह की बेकाबू आदत): An extreme love for collecting books, often to an obsessive degree. • **Example:** His house was overflowing with books due to his bibliomania. • **Anglomania** (अंग्रेजी संस्कृति के प्रति अत्यधिक लगाव): Excessive admiration or obsession with English culture, customs, or language. • **Example:** His anglomania was evident in his love for tea and cricket. 1ba:T984, The correct answer is: **Notorious**.
